title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1475: I am legend (1)

section.p: Inside the safe house.
Everyone was looking at the sky, looking at the projection of the blooming nine-leaf skylotus.
Beside Su Yu, Old Hao gasped and said, “How beautiful.”
Beautiful?
It might not be physically beautiful, but its ability to help one achieve Daofuse would most definitely give one an illusion of beauty.
One divine after another walked out of their rooms. A Sunmoon said, “Can our race win this treasure?”
“It’s hard to say.”
Everyone sank into discussion. Suddenly, a powerful figure appeared in front of the safe house and said, “Open the door.”
A divine king had arrived.

The Pseudo Invincible beside Zhan Wushuang started inspecting the newcomer. The Invincible did not mind it. When the inspection was over, the door swung open. Instantly, the divine king stepped inside.

He did not show any anger toward the Pseudo Invincible. Lan Tian had been murdering people everywhere as of late. And Lan Tian was incredibly hard to detect even for Invincibles. Thus, such wariness was understandable.
“Greetings, Divine King.”
Everyone bowed. The blue-haired divine king nodded. A frosty aura hovered around his body. With a wave of his hand, the door swung shut.
Next, the divine king said, “Return inside. Zhan Wushuang, Yu Sheng, stay.”
Yu Sheng was the Pseudo Invincible beside Zhan Wushuang.

The others wasted no time and returned to their rooms without saying anything. Su Yu did the same with Old Hao since he didn’t have a good excuse to stay outside. Once inside, he asked curiously, “What is the lord doing here?”
Old Hao was rendered speechless. Why was this guy so curious?
When everyone was gone.
The divine king erected a barrier around them with a wave of his arm. He proceeded to scan the two. After he was done, he said, “Did anything odd happen in the safe house?”
“Odd?” The Pseudo Invincible shook his head and said, “No. Things have been calm here.”
“Did anyone leave and return repeatedly?”
“No. The safe house has been locked since we returned. Nobody left after that.”
The divine king nodded and said, “Did you feel threatened as of late?”
Zhan Wushuang nodded, “Yes. I keep feeling like something big is going to happen.”
“You have sharp senses.”
The divine king said, “In that case, it’s unlikely that the threat is hiding among us. Something big is indeed happening. Everyone is waiting for it.”

He continued, “The nine-leaf skylotus will bloom in a few days. At that time, something will definitely happen. Not even the safe house will be safe anymore. All the divines here must survive. These are the elites of our race. We can’t afford to lose them.”
Zhan Wushuang frowned and asked, “Lord, will danger befall this place as well? Will He Tu be here?”
“Yes. Definitely.”
The divine king said, “Even if he can’t, someone will help him. How can they fish in troubled water without chaos?”
Zhan Wushuang asked with surprise, “Is someone…colluding with He Tu?”

“No. They are merely making use of him.” The divine king replied, “This will be useful for us as well. The strongest divine in the mansion is the Lightning Divine King, a seventh-degree Eternal. However, that head from the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion is a ninth-degree Eternal. The Blood Fire Devil King has also sneaked into the mansion. He’s a ninth-degree Eternal. Some top experts of the human race might have sneaked into the mansion as well. The immortals are as mysterious as ever. Without He Tu and the chaos he brings, how can we stand a chance against all those experts?”

Understanding dawned on Zhan Wushuang and Yu Sheng. He Tu must be allowed to enter the seventh level. That would benefit most people. However, that would also put everyone else in danger. At the very least, things would get extremely dangerous for those below the Invincible Realm.
“What should we do, Lord?”
The divine king smiled and said, “I’m here to relocate all of you. But we need to be careful lest we take someone we shouldn’t. That might cause a lot more trouble.”
“Someone we shouldn’t?”
Yu Sheng lowered his voice and asked, “Lan Tian?”

“Lan Tian?” The divine king said, “No. He has countless clones, and he is also very good at hiding himself. However, his transformations can still be seen through. When he shows his real strength, his real aura will leak through. It only lasts for a short moment, but you can still sense it.”
“Not Lan Tian?”
Yu Sheng was surprised. Who could it be, then?
Beside him, Zhan Wushuang’s expression changed slightly as he asked solemnly, “Is he really in here?”
The divine king smiled and said, “It has always been said that fellow geniuses have a unique connection with each other. Did you reach the same conclusion as well?”

Zhan Wushuang said, “I didn’t think of this before, but I grew suspicious after Xuan Wuji and Dao Cheng died. I understnad Mo Duona. Both Dao Cheng and Xuan Wuji were far weaker than him. Mo Duona wouldn’t deign to kill them. Mo Duona is not the type to kill weaklings. He will only kill the dao protectors such as Yang Hu. Nobody else is worthy of his attention.”
The divine king said, “Was that how you became certain that he’s in the mansion?”
“I’m not fully certain.” Zhan Wushuang said, “Only one person from our generation is capable of winning Mo Duona’s respect. And only that person is this murderous.”
The divine king nodded. Beside them, Yu Sheng asked in confusion, “Lord, Wushuang, who are you talking about?”
Zhan Wushuang replied, “Su Yu.”
Yu Sheng exclaimed blankly, “Su Yu?”
“Yes.”

Yu Sheng looked at the divine king again. If it wasn’t for the smile on the divine king’s face, he would have started wondering if Zhan Wushuang had grown overly paranoid after his defeat in Su Yu’s hands.

Even now, very few people suspected that Su Yu was already in the mansion. Only some top experts and those familiar with Mo Duona had such a guess. It was simply too unlikely for Mo Duona to kill Dao Cheng and the others. For some reason, Mo Duona had taken the blame for that feat. A super genius like him would only do so for someone who was an even bigger genius.

The divine king looked at Zhan Wushuang and said, “Exactly. Everyone has the same guess after that incident. Prior to this, we didn’t suspect him. But he was too greedy and ruthless. He was unwilling to spare even one of the immortal geniuses from his generation. As a result, he exposed himself.”
The divine king was speaking the truth. The incident involving Mo Duona was the reason for many of them to start suspecting Su Yu.
Zhan Wushuang asked, “Are you worried that he is hiding among us, Lord?”

“Yeah.” The divine king said, “He won’t be too strong without his ancient cities around. But he’s too good at disguise and concealment. We’re not scared of him. It doesn’t matter how freakish he is. He won’t be able to harm us. But he’s extremely dangerous for the rest of you.”
“Then…”

The divine king cut Zhan Wushuang off and said, “Together with Mo Duona, they are strong enough to kill a Pseudo Invincible. It is hard for us to determine the cause of Zhankui’s death, but Yang Hu must have been killed by the two of them. Together, they are capable of contending against Pseudo Invincibles. Thus, you need to stay wary of him. If an opportunity presents itself, kill him. He’s too scary.”
This was the very first time Zhan Wushuang had ever heard an Invincible speak of a youngster in such a manner. He sank into silence. He did not argue. He agreed that Su Yu was too scary.
Strong, ruthless, cunning, shameless, and good at disguise…

It was likely that nobody would deny the fact that Su Yu was the most shameless genius in the Myriad Realms. Such a shameless genius was extremely rare. Su Yu might act like he was very proud, but he was even better at holding back when necessary.
When someone like that was combined with strength, backers, talent, brains, and a lack of things to lose, he would be an extremely terrifying opponent to have.
Perhaps the sole thing he had to lose was the multiple character faction.

The divine king continued, “He must die. We’re not alone in this. Apart from humanity, every race shares this opinion. It’s worth giving up on even the nine-leaf skylotus to kill him. He will only grow into an even bigger threat after returning to his ancient city. We must kill him here. Some people have been sent to capture Liu Wenyan and the others. Zhan Wushuang, I’m telling you all this to let you know that Mo Duona isn’t a good role model.”

The divine king emphasized, “The divine race will not treat you unfairly. I understand why Mo Duona chose to work with him. He is unwilling to become a mere seed of the Devil Pseudo Emperor. But you are not subjected to such treatment by the divine race. Remember this.”
Zhan Wushuang nodded, “I understand, Lord.”

“No, you don’t. We don’t care about your previous agreement with him. You are free to fulfill the terms of that agreement. When needed, the divine race can fulfill the terms for you as well. But we will only do that once. As fellow geniuses, you can have a friendship with him. But you can’t cooperate with him at a deeper level. You need to understand that Su Yu is cruel and ruthless. Any carelessness can result in a calamity.

“Just look at the heavy losses the immortals have sustained. He is most likely the culprit. An entire generation of future pillars has been erased. The divines and devils have also suffered massively in the mansion. He is most likely the culprit as well. He still has a tiny bit of affection left toward the humans, but he does not hold any goodwill toward us.”
It was rare for a divine king to speak to a non-Invincible so patiently. He was advising Zhan Wushuang on the ways to coexist with Su Yu.
He did not tell Zhan Wushuang what to do. He had merely reminded Zhan Wushuang that between race and the friendship of fellow geniuses, race should be prioritized.
Zhan Wushuang nodded, “I understand.”
“Good.”
